title: We used Claude Opus to help us build a Singleplayer Rogue-lite inspired by Pokémon Rescue Team! Demo out now.
author: AlkrssveGames

comments.author: RecordingTechnical86
comments.body: looks very good. Where did you get the nice pixel art assets?

replies.author: AlkrssveGames
replies.body: Thank you! They came from three different sources. Claude was able to make some sprites very easily with the help of prototyping in Claude's artifact system, some I would have to manually edit, and others I had to do completely. Many of them are still a WIP.

comments.author: Foreign-Quote-53
comments.body: Looks cool but a bit too dark/lacking in contrast imo

replies.author: AlkrssveGames
replies.body: There are comfort settings that allow you to customize the brightness and contrast, we are still working on finding the right balance.

comments.author: Futurefilmdirector
comments.body: Looks fun and I really like the art! Any tips on getting multiple different languages on your game?

replies.author: AlkrssveGames
replies.body: Thank you! Yes, I would recommend building with it in mind from the start. That way you are able address any potential formatting issues with non-Latin languages and you don't risk missing any strings like you would if you did it at the end. If you are using Claude its especially useful to open an artifact with all the strings and show all translations side by side to try and ensure accuracy. It's definitely not perfect though lol

replies.author: Futurefilmdirector
replies.body: Ooo yeah that makes sense. I'll have to try out Claude for sure.

comments.author: Revolutionary_Heart6
comments.body: Great game. altho i think for small audience. the art style and roguelike elements make it good for gamer boomers. but gamer boomers dont have the wrist and apm needed to play it effectively i think haha

replies.author: AlkrssveGames
replies.body: Yeaaah not everyone has loved the mechanics lol. Many have said they'd play it if it was a phone game so its easier on the wrist so the plan is to port soon after launch. Appreciate the feedback!

comments.author: DearCriticism5747
comments.body: What engine and is it avail for play test

replies.author: AlkrssveGames
replies.body: We are using Godot 4 and the demos available on Itch or Steam to play. Feel free to provide feedback in our discord!

comments.author: AshlaStudios
comments.body: I really like the art style, managed to make it look not at all like AI. Can you share some of your workflows? What is your process? And I don't mean just asset generation, also how this art style came about, smaller aspects of it.
